sentences.text:
The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita ... vs In Re : Ramdas
Sarkar on 1 October, 2024

Author: Joymalya Bagchi
Bench: Joymalya Bagchi
01.10.2024
tkm/ct 6 C.R.R. 3446 of 2024
sl no.10
 In Re : An application under section 482 Cr.P.C (presently section 528 of
 the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023)

And  In Re : Ramdas Sarkar ....... petitio  Mr. S C Atha  ...... for the petitioner  1.
Petitioner submits opposite party no. 2 is residing at her parental home since 2016.
After about a decade she instituted impugned criminal proceeding against the petitioner/husband.
2. We have considered the allegations in the impugned FIR.
It is admitted in the FIR opposite party no. 2 is living separately for last eight years.
Allegation with regard to cruelty in June 2023 is woefully vague and non-specific.
Possibility of belated and malicious institution of criminal proceeding to harass the petitioner cannot be ruled out.

3. Copy of the petition be served upon the opposite party no. 1/State through learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon opposite party no. 2 through registered speed post with acknowledgement due and affidavit of service be filed on the next date of hearing.
4. Let the mater appear under the heading 'Contested Application' four weeks after Puja vacation.
5.

There shall be stay of operation of the proceeding being GR case no. 1456 of 2024 corresponding to Kanksa PS case no. 241 of 2024 dated 20.7.2024 under section 498A/323/406/34 IPC pending before the ACJM Durgapur Paschim Burdwan for a period of six weeks after puja vacation or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
6. Liberty is given to the parties to pray for extension and/or vacation and/or modification of this order upon notice to the other side.
